entries.title: Job 28:1
segments: ¶"Surely there is a mine for silver, And a place [where] gold is refined.

entries.title: Job 28:2
segments: Iron is taken from the earth, And copper [is] smelted [from] ore.

entries.title: Job 28:3
segments: [Man] puts an end to darkness, And searches every recess For ore in the darkness and the shadow of death.

entries.title: Job 28:4
segments: He breaks open a shaft away from people; [In places] forgotten by feet They hang far away from men; They swing to and fro.

entries.title: Job 28:5
segments: [As for] the earth, from it comes bread, But underneath it is turned up as by fire;

entries.title: Job 28:6
segments: Its stones [are] the source of sapphires, And it contains gold dust.

entries.title: Job 28:7
segments: [That] path no bird knows, Nor has the falcon's eye seen it.

entries.title: Job 28:8
segments: The proud lions have not trodden it, Nor has the fierce lion passed over it.

entries.title: Job 28:9
segments: He puts his hand on the flint; He overturns the mountains at the roots.

entries.title: Job 28:10
segments: He cuts out channels in the rocks, And his eye sees every precious thing.

entries.title: Job 28:11
segments: He dams up the streams from trickling; [What is] hidden he brings forth to light.

entries.title: Job 28:12
segments: "But where can wisdom be found? And where [is] the place of understanding?

entries.title: Job 28:13
segments: Man does not know its value, Nor is it found in the land of the living.

entries.title: Job 28:14
segments: ¶The deep says, '[It is] not in me'; And the sea says, '[It is] not with me.'

entries.title: Job 28:15
segments: It cannot be purchased for gold, Nor can silver be weighed [for] its price.

entries.title: Job 28:16
segments: It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, In precious onyx or sapphire.

entries.title: Job 28:17
segments: Neither gold nor crystal can equal it, Nor can it be exchanged for jewelry of fine gold.

entries.title: Job 28:18
segments: No mention shall be made of coral or quartz, For the price of wisdom [is] above rubies.

entries.title: Job 28:19
segments: The topaz of Ethiopia cannot equal it, Nor can it be valued in pure gold.

entries.title: Job 28:20
segments: ¶"From where then does wisdom come? And where [is] the place of understanding?

entries.title: Job 28:21
segments: It is hidden from the eyes of all living, And concealed from the birds of the air.

entries.title: Job 28:22
segments: Destruction and Death say, 'We have heard a report about it with our ears.'

entries.title: Job 28:23
segments: God understands its way, And He knows its place.

entries.title: Job 28:24
segments: For He looks to the ends of the earth, [And] sees under the whole heavens,

entries.title: Job 28:25
segments: To establish a weight for the wind, And apportion the waters by measure.

entries.title: Job 28:26
segments: When He made a law for the rain, And a path for the thunderbolt,

entries.title: Job 28:27
segments: Then He saw [wisdom] and declared it; He prepared it, indeed, He searched it out.

entries.title: Job 28:28
segments: And to man He said, 'Behold, the fear of the Lord, that [is] wisdom, And to depart from evil [is] understanding.'"
